name: CyclingVQA
description: CyclingVQA is a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models on cyclist-centric perception, spatio-temporal understanding, and traffic-rule-to-lane reasoning. It probes models' abilities to interpret cyclist-specific traffic cues and associate signs with correct navigational lanes in urban traffic scenarios.
reputation: A specialized diagnostic benchmark that is useful for cyclist-centric VLM evaluation, but it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Evaluates 31+ recent VLMs; highlights gaps in cyclist-assistive perception and reasoning.
